 Oral Order
2 12-07-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

The present writ petition has been filed by the petitioner seeking direction to the District Magistrate-cum- Collector, Aurangabad to accept the application filed under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 (hereinafter referred to as "RFCTLARRA") and dispose off the same on merit and refer the matter before Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation, and Resettlement Authority, Gaya (hereinafter Patna High Court CWJC No.2743 of 2023(2) dt.12-07-2023 referred to as "LARRA") for reference.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the award notice arising out of L.A. No.03 of 2007-08 was served upon the petitioner and others as by the said L.A. Case No.03 of 2007-08 the lands of 9 different villages were acquired.

He further submits that some of the villagers have been Kumar Ohm vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177147249/
1 aggrieved by the said award and moved before this Hon'ble Court in writ petition and the dispute traveled up to Letters Patent Appeal.

entities.text: Kumar Ohm vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel fairly submits that the present petitioner started waiting for the result of that L.P.A. because the issue directly and substantially of the petitioner and those of other villagers who moved in CWJC and thereafter in L.P.A. are basically same.
He further submits that till waiting the result of other similarly situated persons there is some delay in filing application under Section 64 of the RFCTLARRA, 2013 for reference.
Learned counsel for the State submits that one year has already been lapsed and, therefore, the petitioner has no remedy left now.

Considering the circumstances, the District Magistrate-cum-Collector, Aurangabad is directed to consider the case of petitioner under Section 64 of the RFCTLARRA, Patna High Court CWJC No.2743 of 2023(2) dt.12-07-2023 2013 and shall pass order on merit and shall refer the matter for reference before LARRA, Gaya.
With this observation and direction, the present Writ Petition stands disposed off.

(Dr. Anshuman, J.) Ritik/-
